summary: PRF Technologies Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on September 3, 2026, reporting its unaudited condensed financial statements and operating review for the six months ended June 30, 2026, along with a press release. No special-situation corporate event, such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring, is disclosed. The filing is a routine periodic report, incorporated by reference into existing registration statements. No deal terms, board recommendations, or strategic actions are present. This is a standard earnings and financial disclosure filing, not a special situation.
